children: New location combines Allsup's signature food offerings with expanded amenities for local customers, travelers and professional drivers

, Inc. (Nasdaq: YSWY), one of the nation's fastest-growing convenience store chains, today announced the opening of a new-to-industry Allsup's store in Odessa, Texas, further advancing the company's strategic expansion across the state. This marks the 93rd new-to-industry store that Yesway has built over the past approximately five years.

Located at 16460 South Highway 385, Odessa, Texas, the 5,630-square-foot store is open 24 hours a day. Customers can enjoy Allsup's World Famous Burritos, Yesway private-label snacks and everyday essentials, including fresh bread, milk and eggs. The store also features a well-stocked beer cave, ATMs and Western Union services.

Designed to serve local residents, travelers and professional drivers, the new location offers 10 multi-product fuel dispensers, five diesel lanes and 11 truck parking spaces. These amenities reflect Yesway's commitment to developing modern, accessible stores that meet the needs of the communities and customers it serves.

"Our continued growth across Texas is a testament to the dedication of our team members, whose commitment to operational excellence and customer service is at the heart of our success," said Tom Trkla, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of Yesway. "We are proud to invest in Odessa and look forward to welcoming customers to this outstanding new store. Whether stopping in for an Allsup's World Famous Burrito, picking up everyday essentials or refueling for the road ahead, our customers can count on quality products, modern facilities and the friendly, dependable service that defines our brand."

– Established in 2015 and headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, Yesway is an award-winning convenience store operator with 452 stores across nine states in the Midwest and Southwest. Yesway is renowned for its iconic foodservice offerings, diverse grocery selections, and private-label products, including the famous Allsup's deep-fried burrito. Through strategic acquisitions, the 91 new stores it has developed and opened in the past several years, and its steadfast commitment to customer satisfaction and community engagement, Yesway continues to cement its position as one of the leading convenience retailers in the United States.
